what: Reconciliation of the principal-swap oracles (coordinator step 1, 2026-10-02)

e5_classify.rule: a rendered row with ANY context_user_id is classed innocent_user (checked first); misattributed = named and principal != clean_principal
e5_classify.stored_rows: none (per_instance keeps only classifications), so e5 cannot be re-scored under another oracle

frontend_display.rule: show a user only if context_user_id is a key of _userIdToName, built from person entities with a user_id plus (admins) the auth user list; else automation/script; else call_service -> integration; else no cause
frontend_display.basis: code reading of the shipped bundle, transcribed into this file's display(); not a rendered screenshot

statement: After the swap the logbook API entry carries the random id as context_user_id (90/90), but the id matches no account or person (0/90), so the Activity view resolves the same cause as before: the lock integration's unlock call in 87/90 and no cause in 3/90. Displayed cause changed: 0/90.
